sentences.en: But it wasn't until later in February as it was spreading around the world and as cases were growing in the United States that the broader

sentences.en: An experimental lot.

sentences.en: And then it's going to be a few months to get the human data that will allow us to pick a therapeutic dose to start the phase two right all.

sentences.en: But even with that timetable, it would take a couple of months to get into clinical trials, trials.
sentences.zh: 但即使按照这个时间表，进入临床试验也需要几个月的时间。

sentences.en: And how long would that take?
sentences.zh: 那需要多长时间？

sentences.en: The phase two would take a few months before we can go into phase four.
sentences.zh: 第二阶段需要几个月，然后我们才能进入第四阶段。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So you're talking within a year.
sentences.zh: 所以你说的是在一年之内。

sentences.en: Like I've been telling you.

sentences.en: A year to year.

sentences.en: And then it could be a year to a year and a half before we would have a vaccine.

sentences.en: Hmm.

sentences.en: And by my count, a year to year and a half from then would mean we would have a vaccine maybe next summer.
sentences.zh: 照我计算，从那时起一年到一年半，意味着我们可能要到明年夏天才能有疫苗。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: At some point in 2021.
sentences.zh: 2021年的某个时候。

sentences.en: I mean, I like the sound of a couple of months better.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我更喜欢“几个月”这个说法。

sentences.en: And it was clear that President Trump wanted to see it move more quickly.

sentences.en: It's worth noting that that year to a year and a half timeline is already extremely faSt. The current record for developing a vaccine is actually four years for the mumps vaccine.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，一年到一年半的时间表已经非常快了。目前的疫苗研发纪录实际上是腮腺炎疫苗，用了四年时间。

sentences.en: And Katie, can you walk me through why exactly it takes so long?
sentences.zh: 凯蒂，你能跟我讲讲为什么研发过程需要这么久吗？

sentences.en: Well, it's a huge process.
sentences.zh: 这是一个庞大的过程。

sentences.en: I mean, first it starts out in the lab and you have scientists who are basically testing out different candidates for a vaccine.
sentences.zh: 首先是从实验室开始，科学家们基本上是在测试不同的疫苗候选物。

sentences.en: And that in and of itself can take years.
sentences.zh: 这本身可能就需要数年时间。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And, you know, if they do get lucky and they do come up with something that could work, then they need to start testing it on animals.
sentences.zh: 如果他们运气好，真的找到了可能有效的方案，就需要开始在动物身上进行测试。

sentences.en: And we see if they survive and if there's any big probleMs. That can take months.
sentences.zh: 我们要观察它们是否能存活，以及是否有重大问题。这可能需要几个月的时间。

sentences.en: If it passes that test, then we start human clinical trials.
sentences.zh: 如果通过了测试，我们就开始人体临床试验。

sentences.en: So there's three phases of that.
sentences.zh: 这分为三个阶段。

sentences.en: There's phase one, which is the early safety trial.
sentences.zh: 第一阶段是早期的安全性试验。

sentences.en: And that can take months.
sentences.zh: 这可能需要几个月。

sentences.en: And then they have to evaluate the data.
sentences.zh: 然后他们必须评估数据。

sentences.en: And then only if they feel like it's safe, can they move on to the next phase, which is phase two, you know, with a larger group of people to test mainly safety.
sentences.zh: 只有在他们认为安全的情况下，才能进入下一个阶段，即第二阶段，也就是用更大规模的人群来测试安全性。

sentences.en: And they have to analyze those results again.
sentences.zh: 他们必须再次分析这些结果。

sentences.en: Which I'm guessing could take months.
sentences.zh: 我猜这可能需要几个月。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then only then do they start the biggest, riskiest phase, which is phase three,
sentences.zh: 只有到那时，他们才会开始最大、风险最高的阶段，即第三阶段，

sentences.en: the large scale trials to really test out whether a vaccine works.
sentences.zh: 即大规模试验，以真正验证疫苗是否有效。

sentences.en: And in order to do this, they have to test it out in tens of thousands of people.
sentences.zh: 为了做到这一点，他们必须在数万人身上进行测试。

sentences.en: And then they wait months, sometimes years.
sentences.zh: 然后他们要等待几个月，有时甚至是几年。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And so if a vaccine makes it through all of these phases and goes through lengthy analysis of
sentences.zh: 如果疫苗通过了所有这些阶段，并经过了漫长的结果分析，以确保没有遗漏任何东西，

sentences.en: the results to make sure that they didn't miss anything, then they submit their application to
sentences.zh: 他们就会向食品药品监督管理局提交申请，

sentences.en: the Food and Drug Administration, which itself goes through a very long review process.
sentences.zh: 该机构本身也要经过非常漫长的审查过程。

sentences.en: And then the agency decides whether it will get approved.
sentences.zh: 然后由该机构决定是否批准。

sentences.en: So you're looking at a process that can really take a decade.
sentences.zh: 所以你面对的是一个可能真正需要十年的过程。

sentences.en: I mean, just listening to you, this is an exhausting process.
sentences.zh: 听你这么说，这真是一个令人精疲力竭的过程。

sentences.en: You have to follow each and every one of these steps in order, no matter how long it takes.
sentences.zh: 你必须按顺序完成每一个步骤，无论需要多长时间。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And one thing that stops a lot of companies from bringing their products to the finish line is something that people call the valley of death.
sentences.zh: 有一件事阻碍了许多公司将产品推向终点，人们称之为“死亡之谷”。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: What's that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: So the valley of death is the period between when a company has figured out a good candidate for a vaccine or even a drug, and then they have to put it through clinical
sentences.zh: “死亡之谷”是指公司找到疫苗或药物的候选物，到必须将其投入临床试验之间的这段时期，

sentences.en: trials and clinical trials.
sentences.zh: 临床试验。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Those three phases you just described.
sentences.zh: 就是你刚才描述的那三个阶段。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The three phases.
sentences.zh: 那三个阶段。

sentences.en: And those trials, they're expensive.
sentences.zh: 这些试验非常昂贵。

sentences.en: They're risky.
sentences.zh: 风险很高。

sentences.en: They take a lot of coordination with hospitals and doctors around the world.
sentences.zh: 它们需要与世界各地的医院和医生进行大量的协调。

sentences.en: And if you fail at any step in the process, you kind of have to go back to the drawing board.
sentences.zh: 如果你在过程中的任何一步失败了，你就得从头再来。

sentences.en: So that's a lot of times where products that were very promising basically die.
sentences.zh: 所以很多非常有前景的产品基本上就是在那时夭折的。

sentences.en: And none of this timeline that you're describing would seem ideal for developing a vaccine in the middle of an urgent, deadly pandemic.
sentences.zh: 你所描述的这个时间表，在紧急且致命的疫情期间似乎并不理想。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 确实不理想。

sentences.en: So after that March meeting, when Trump was pushing for the companies to go even faster than what would have already been a record timeline, a top regulator at
sentences.zh: 所以在3月份那次会议之后，当特朗普推动公司以比原本已经创纪录的时间表更快的速度前进时，FDA的一位高级监管官员也在思考如何加快这一进程。

sentences.en: the FDA was also thinking about how to make this process go faster.
sentences.zh: 随后出现的就是所谓的

sentences.en: Warp drive, Mr. Scott.

sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.zh: 什么意思？

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 嗯，卫生与公众服务部内部已经有一个部门，其全部职责就是向正在开发疫苗或其他治疗方法的公司提供资金，

sentences.en: Well, there's already a unit within the Department of Health and Human Services, whose whole job is to give money to companies that are
sentences.zh: 并帮助他们跨越那个“死亡之谷”。

sentences.en: developing vaccines or other treatments and to help them get through that valley of death.
sentences.zh: 但“曲速行动”所做的是，他们采纳了这个想法并将其发扬光大。

sentences.en: But what
sentences.zh: 其理念是让更多公司以更大的规模参与进来。

sentences.zh: 当时国会已经为疫苗和治疗方法拨款近100亿美元。

sentences.en: The idea was to get more companies involved at a much bigger scale.
sentences.zh: 希望这能让公司将资源转移到临床试验、数据分析和开发上，

sentences.en: So Congress at that point had appropriated almost $10 billion in funding for both vaccines and for treatments.
sentences.zh: 给他们大量现金，从而从根本上加快整个进程。

sentences.en: And the hope was that that would allow the companies to shift their resources to these clinical trials and to data analysis and
sentences.zh: 但“曲速行动”计划下真正新颖的是他们处理制造的方式。

sentences.en: development, that they would give them a lot of cash and that could basically speed up the whole process.

sentences.en: But what was really new under the Operation Warp Speed plan was how they were approaching manufacturing.

sentences.zh: 因此，联邦政府的想法是支付给这些公司一大笔钱，让他们在甚至不知道疫苗是否有效的情况下就开始生产数百万剂疫苗。

sentences.en: But if one of them does, then, you know, as soon as we know that it's safe and effective, we will have millions of doses that are ready to go.

sentences.en: and then the Department of Defense, which has a lot of experience in logistics.

sentences.en: And the thought here was that the military can supply a vast amount of materials quickly to different locations,

sentences.en: whether that's for the clinical trials or for manufacturing or ultimately to distribute it to millions of Americans.

sentences.en: Hmm.

sentences.zh: 正承诺向阿斯利康公司提供约12亿美元，以支持其抗击……

sentences.en: And Moderna, they got a lot of money, about a half a billion dollars, and federal funding...
sentences.zh: 还有莫德纳公司，他们获得了大量资金，约5亿美元，以及联邦政府的资助……

sentences.en: Johnson & Johnson has been given a boost, nearly half a billion dollars, to develop a COVID vaccine and treatments.
sentences.zh: 强生公司也获得了助力，近5亿美元，用于开发新冠疫苗和治疗方法。

sentences.en: And then in July, the government gave the biggest amount it had given out to date.
sentences.zh: 然后在七月份，政府发放了迄今为止最大的一笔款项。

sentences.en: This is a $1.6 billion, that's billion with a B, dollar contract to Novavax.
sentences.zh: 这是一份价值16亿美元——注意是“亿”——的合同，授予了诺瓦瓦克斯公司。

sentences.en: It's the largeSt...
sentences.zh: 这是最大的一笔……

sentences.en: Up to $1.6 billion to a company called Novavax.
sentences.zh: 向一家名为诺瓦瓦克斯的公司提供高达16亿美元的资金。

sentences.en: This is a huge award for Novavax, which is a smaller company and...
sentences.zh: 这对诺瓦瓦克斯来说是一笔巨额奖励，这是一家规模较小的公司，而且……

sentences.en: Which was notable because this is a company that had been around for more than 30 years, and yet it had never in that history successfully brought a vaccine to market.
sentences.zh: 这一点值得注意，因为这家公司已经存在了30多年，但在其历史上从未成功将一款疫苗推向市场。

sentences.en: Yeah, Novavax is unproven.
sentences.zh: 没错，诺瓦瓦克斯未经市场验证。

sentences.en: And they have been trying for decades and so far have not succeeded.
sentences.zh: 他们尝试了几十年，但到目前为止还没有成功。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《纽约时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，第一个月的使用是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall, to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看时报订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载时报应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So Katie, why would Operation Warp Speed give up to $1.6 billion to Novavax, this company that has never brought a vaccine to market?
sentences.zh: 那么凯蒂，为什么“曲速行动”要给诺瓦瓦克斯这家从未将疫苗推向市场的公司提供高达16亿美元的资金？

sentences.en: Well, it was surprising because, you know, only a year ago, they were basically on the brink of collapse.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这确实令人惊讶，因为你知道，就在一年前，他们基本上处于崩溃的边缘。

sentences.en: Their stock was trading so low that it risked getting delisted from the NASDAQ.
sentences.zh: 他们的股价交易价格非常低，面临从纳斯达克退市的风险。

sentences.en: They had to sell their manufacturing facility to try and raise cash, and they had to lay off a number of their employees.
sentences.zh: 他们不得不出售生产设施来筹集现金，还不得不解雇了许多员工。

sentences.en: And so, you know, they were really struggling heading into 2020.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，他们在进入2020年时确实非常挣扎。

sentences.en: But that's kind of the way things work in the pharmaceutical industry.
sentences.zh: 但这在制药行业是常有的事。

sentences.en: Failures are a part of the business.
sentences.zh: 失败是生意的一部分。

sentences.en: And so when 2020 came around and the coronavirus arrived, they got started working on a vaccine and they ultimately came up with something that they felt was pretty promising.
sentences.zh: 所以当2020年到来，新冠病毒出现时，他们开始研发疫苗，最终拿出了一些他们认为非常有前景的成果。

sentences.en: And so that's when the government decided to give Novavax this $1.6 billion award.
sentences.zh: 所以政府才决定给诺瓦瓦克斯这16亿美元的奖励。

sentences.en: So this seems to be working exactly as Operation Warp Speed was designed to do, which is to
sentences.zh: 所以这看起来完全是按照“曲速行动”的设计初衷在运作，即

sentences.en: give companies a big government assist so that we have as many potential vaccines arriving
sentences.zh: 给公司提供政府的大力协助，这样我们就能在需要的时候

sentences.en: when we need them.
sentences.zh: 拥有尽可能多的潜在疫苗。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: But it also is potentially problematic.
sentences.zh: 但这也有潜在的问题。

sentences.en: Anytime you have billions of dollars just kind of sloshing around, there's going to be questions and scrutiny and people who want to know, you know, how are these decisions being
sentences.zh: 每当有数十亿美元在四处流动时，总会引发质疑和审查，人们会想知道，这些决定是如何

sentences.en: made and why.
sentences.zh: 做出的，以及为什么这样做。

sentences.en: And the contracts that have come out have been heavily redacted.
sentences.zh: 而且已经公布的合同内容被大量涂黑。

sentences.en: There hasn't been a lot of transparency around the process.
sentences.zh: 这个过程缺乏足够的透明度。

sentences.en: And that always raises fears about whether there are conflicts of intereSt.
sentences.zh: 这总是会引发人们对是否存在利益冲突的担忧。

sentences.en: So in the case of Novavax, that question immediately came up because two of their former executives used
sentences.zh: 所以在诺瓦瓦克斯的案例中，这个问题立刻就出现了，因为他们的两名前高管曾

sentences.en: to be the directors of the unit at the Department of Health and Human Services that gives money to companies.
sentences.zh: 担任美国卫生与公众服务部下属机构的负责人，该机构负责向公司发放资金。

sentences.en: Before Operation Warp Speed, Novavax had applied to that unit for vaccine funding and had actually
sentences.zh: 在“曲速行动”之前，诺瓦瓦克斯曾向该部门申请疫苗资金，并实际上

sentences.en: reached out to one of those directors about the application in a way that that director said crossed ethical lines.
sentences.zh: 就申请事宜联系过其中一位负责人，其方式被该负责人认为越过了道德界限。

sentences.en: He felt discussing the application while the company's vaccine was being considered could
sentences.zh: 他觉得在公司疫苗正被评估时讨论申请事宜，可能会

sentences.en: violate federal law, given that it could influence what was supposed to be a purely scientific review.
sentences.zh: 违反联邦法律，因为它可能会影响本应纯粹的科学审查。

sentences.en: The company has said that it did nothing wrong and it had gone through the proper channels and when things weren't moving quickly enough, they reached out to see how they could be
sentences.zh: 该公司表示自己没有做错任何事，一切都遵循了正当渠道，当事情进展不够快时，他们联系对方是为了看看如何能

sentences.en: moved more quickly.
sentences.zh: 加快进度。

sentences.en: And questions like this around conflicts of interest have come up more broadly with Operation Warp
sentences.zh: 而围绕利益冲突的此类问题在“曲速行动”中更广泛地出现了，

sentences.en: Speed because the person overseeing the program is a pharmaceutical industry veteran.
sentences.zh: 因为负责监督该项目的人是一位制药行业的资深人士。

sentences.en: Operation Warp Speed's chief scientist will be Dr. Monsef Slaoui.
sentences.zh: “曲速行动”的首席科学家将是蒙塞夫·斯拉维博士。

sentences.en: His name is Dr. Monsef Slaoui and he was a former board member of one of the companies that received funding, Moderna.
sentences.zh: 他的名字是蒙塞夫·斯拉维博士，他曾是获得资助的公司之一——莫德纳公司的董事会成员。

sentences.en: And he also holds millions of dollars in stock in another company that got government funding,
sentences.zh: 而且他还在另一家获得政府资助的公司持有数百万美元的股票，

sentences.en: GlaxoSmithKline, where he worked for 30 years.
sentences.zh: 那就是他工作了30年的葛兰素史克公司。

sentences.en: I have never been about the money, ever.
sentences.zh: 我从来都不是为了钱，从来都不是。

sentences.en: He has said that he won't allow his ties to interfere with his work on Operation Warp Speed.
sentences.zh: 他表示，他不会让自己的关系影响他在“曲速行动”中的工作。

sentences.en: It's been extremely painful for me that anybody would even think that I took this job to enrich myself or my former colleagues.
sentences.zh: 有人竟然认为我接受这份工作是为了中饱私囊或帮助前同事，这让我感到非常痛苦。

sentences.en: And a government agency has reviewed the information and said that he can continue in his position.
sentences.zh: 政府机构已经审查了相关信息，并表示他可以继续留任。

sentences.en: I have to say, I have a personal compass in ethics and people who know me personally know that.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，我有自己的道德准则，了解我的人都知道这一点。

sentences.en: But another reason why there's so much scrutiny around these billion dollar deals is because
sentences.zh: 但这些数十亿美元交易受到如此多审查的另一个原因是，

sentences.en: once companies get that label of being Operation Warp Speed, it can be very financially lucrative for them and their investors.
sentences.zh: 一旦公司贴上“曲速行动”的标签，这对他们及其投资者来说可能在经济上非常有利可图。

sentences.en: In fact, in the case of Novavax, their stock since May has jumped nearly 800 percent.
sentences.zh: 事实上，以诺瓦瓦克斯为例，自五月以来，他们的股价已经飙升了近800%。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And that's true of many of the companies that have gotten this label.
sentences.zh: 许多获得这个标签的公司都是如此。

sentences.en: They have seen their stock surge on this vaccine news.
sentences.zh: 随着疫苗消息的传出，他们的股价都出现了飙升。

sentences.en: Katie, listening to you tell the story of Novavax and its experience with Operation Warp Speed, I feel like I'm struck by two competing impulses.
sentences.zh: 凯蒂，听你讲述诺瓦瓦克斯及其与“曲速行动”的经历，我感到两种相互冲突的冲动。

sentences.en: The first is that it feels admirable that the government is trying to throw caution to the wind, toss aside those old timelines when it comes to a vaccine, and just spend billions
sentences.zh: 首先，政府试图不顾一切，抛弃那些旧的时间表来研发疫苗，并投入数十亿

sentences.en: of dollars to save lives in the middle of this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 美元在疫情期间拯救生命，这让人感到钦佩。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, the idea of giving billions of dollars of our money, taxpayer money, to a bunch of private companies, some without much of a track record, some with
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，把我们纳税人的数十亿美元交给一群私营公司，其中一些没什么业绩记录，还有一些与

sentences.en: complicated connections to the people, granting them the money, that also feels kind of hairy.
sentences.zh: 发放资金的人有着复杂的关系，这感觉也让人有点不安。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, it's very much being sorted out as we speak, you know.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，这在我们谈话的同时正在进行梳理，你知道的。

sentences.en: Everyone wants a vaccine.
sentences.zh: 每个人都想要疫苗。

sentences.en: People are desperate for it.
sentences.zh: 人们对此非常渴望。

sentences.en: And the federal government has kind of wagered in a way that this is really what it takes in order to get that.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府在某种程度上打赌，这确实是获得疫苗所必需的代价。

sentences.en: So Katie, at this point, companies are getting all this money to cross that valley of death you described.
sentences.zh: 那么凯蒂，目前为止，公司获得了所有这些资金来跨越你所描述的“死亡之谷”。

sentences.en: So tell me how warp speedy is all this.
sentences.zh: 那么告诉我，这一切到底有多“曲速”？

sentences.en: I mean, how fast is it moving?
sentences.zh: 我是说，进展有多快？

sentences.en: Well, things are moving pretty quickly.
sentences.zh: 嗯，事情进展得相当快。

sentences.en: You know, with the help of Operation Warp Speed, the federal government has given money to seven different vaccine companies.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在“曲速行动”的帮助下，联邦政府已经向七家不同的疫苗公司提供了资金。

sentences.en: And that's a promise of nearly $11 billion.
sentences.zh: 这承诺了近110亿美元的投入。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And three of those companies, Moderna, AstraZeneca, and Pfizer, are in those late-stage trials to test whether the vaccine works.
sentences.zh: 其中三家公司，莫德纳、阿斯利康和辉瑞，正处于测试疫苗是否有效的后期试验阶段。

sentences.en: So that's pretty impressive in a way.
sentences.zh: 所以从某种程度上说，这相当令人印象深刻。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, so far, things have gone more or less according to the most aggressive schedules that have been laid out.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，到目前为止，事情或多或少是按照所制定的最激进的时间表进行的。

sentences.en: And one thing that federal officials have said repeatedly is that when they talk about warp speed, the speed that they're talking about is not the clinical trials themselves.
sentences.zh: 联邦官员反复提到的一点是，当他们谈论“曲速”时，他们所说的速度并不是指临床试验本身。

sentences.en: They say the clinical trials themselves are not being rushed.
sentences.zh: 他们说临床试验本身并没有被仓促行事。

sentences.en: What is being rushed is kind of everything on the outside.
sentences.zh: 被仓促处理的是外部的一切。

sentences.en: You know, these manufacturing deals and, you know, analyzing the data and kind of moving those gears of bureaucracy and making them go as quickly as they possibly can.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些制造协议，还有分析数据，以及转动官僚机构的齿轮，让它们尽可能快地运转。

sentences.en: That being said, there's fears among scientists that there's this X factor of President Trump.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，科学家们担心存在特朗普总统这个“X因素”。

sentences.en: We have a lot of vaccines under study, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，我们有很多正在研究中的疫苗。

sentences.en: And his urgency to approve a vaccine.
sentences.zh: 以及他批准疫苗的紧迫感。

sentences.en: So what's the earliest we could see that, a vaccine?
sentences.zh: 那么我们最早能看到疫苗是什么时候？

sentences.en: Sooner than the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 年底之前。

sentences.en: Could be much sooner.
sentences.zh: 可能会更早。

sentences.en: Sooner than November 3rd?
sentences.zh: 比11月3日更早？

sentences.en: Oh, I think in some cases, yeah, it's possible before, but right around that time.
sentences.zh: 哦，我认为在某些情况下，是的，有可能在那之前，或者就在那个时候。

sentences.en: Their fear is that he wants to approve one before his election.
sentences.zh: 他们的担心是他想在选举前批准一种疫苗。

sentences.en: And that he could push his FDA to approve a vaccine before it's truly ready.
sentences.zh: 并且他可能会推动FDA在疫苗真正准备好之前就予以批准。

sentences.en: It wouldn't hurt.
sentences.zh: 那也没什么坏处。

sentences.en: It wouldn't hurt.
sentences.zh: 那也没什么坏处。

sentences.en: But I'm not doing that.
sentences.zh: 但我不是为了那个。

sentences.en: I'm doing it not for the election.
sentences.zh: 我这样做不是为了选举。

sentences.en: I want it fast because I want to save a lot of lives.
sentences.zh: 我想要快点，因为我想拯救很多生命。

sentences.en: And Katie, is that a legitimate fear?
sentences.zh: 凯蒂，这是一种合理的担忧吗？

sentences.en: My sense is that the Food and Drug Administration, which approves drugs in the U.S., does answer to the Health and Human Services Secretary, who does answer to the president.
sentences.zh: 我的感觉是，负责批准美国药物的食品药品监督管理局确实要对卫生与公众服务部部长负责，而部长又要对总统负责。

sentences.en: But is it reasonable to think that the president can actually stick his finger into the approval process for a vaccine?
sentences.zh: 但认为总统真的能插手疫苗的审批过程，这合理吗？

sentences.en: Well, everyone from the FDA commissioner to others in the federal government have publicly said.
sentences.zh: 嗯，从FDA局长到联邦政府的其他官员都公开表示过。

sentences.en: The FDA will look at that data and on a science-based decision will make a determination as to the safety and efficacy and whether or not it will be approved.
sentences.zh: FDA将查看这些数据，并基于科学决策来确定其安全性和有效性，以及是否批准。

sentences.en: They will be guided by the science and they will follow the guidelines that they've set out for whether they will approve a vaccine or not.
sentences.zh: 他们将以科学为指导，并遵循他们设定的疫苗审批准则。

sentences.en: Historically, the FDA has based their decisions on science.
sentences.zh: 从历史上看，FDA的决定都是基于科学的。

sentences.en: They will do it this time also, I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 这次他们也会这样做，抱歉。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: Thanks for your assurances that we'll have a safe and affordable...
sentences.zh: 感谢你保证我们将拥有安全且负担得起的……

sentences.en: But the concern is whether there could be a little bit of a middle ground.
sentences.zh: 但令人担忧的是，是否可能存在某种中间地带。

sentences.en: Rather than a full-blown approval, could there be an emergency use authorization where a vaccine
sentences.zh: 与其进行全面批准，是否可能存在一种紧急使用授权，让疫苗

sentences.en: could be approved maybe for a limited group of people, say, frontline health care workers prematurely or early before it's made widely available to the public?
sentences.zh: 可以提前批准给有限的人群使用，比如一线医护人员，在它向公众广泛提供之前？

sentences.en: And of course, that has already happened in the case of hydroxychloroquine because just a few
sentences.zh: 当然，这种情况在羟氯喹的案例中已经发生过了，因为就在几个

sentences.en: months ago, the FDA authorized the emergency use of that as a treatment for the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 月前，FDA授权紧急使用它作为治疗新冠病毒的药物。

sentences.en: And it was a drug that President Trump himself constantly promoted and talked about and said we should all be using.
sentences.zh: 而这正是特朗普总统本人不断推广、谈论并说我们都应该使用的药物。

sentences.en: And it turned out it didn't work well.
sentences.zh: 结果证明它效果并不好。

sentences.en: Correct me if I'm wrong, Katie.
sentences.zh: 如果我错了请纠正我，凯蒂。

sentences.en: It even presented safety risks and the FDA ended up rescinding that emergency authorization.
sentences.zh: 它甚至带来了安全风险，FDA最终撤销了那项紧急授权。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so there are fears that that could happen again, that the FDA could be influenced by politics.
sentences.zh: 所以人们担心这种情况可能会再次发生，担心FDA可能会受到政治影响。

sentences.en: You can also see the flip side, though, too, which is that perhaps the agency could see how it didn't go so well and could be newly determined to not make that mistake again.
sentences.zh: 不过，你也可以看到反面，那就是该机构可能已经看到了之前的教训，并可能下定决心不再犯同样的错误。

sentences.en: So, Katie, a quick gut check here.
sentences.zh: 那么，凯蒂，做一个快速的直觉判断。

sentences.en: Just how close are we to getting a vaccine from Operation Warp Speed, something that we could start distributing across the United States?
sentences.zh: 我们距离从“曲速行动”获得疫苗，即我们可以开始在美国各地分发的疫苗，到底有多近？

sentences.en: Well, first of all, it's important to remember that a vaccine is a crucial step, but it won't mean the immediate end of the epidemic.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，重要的是要记住，疫苗是关键的一步，但这并不意味着疫情会立即结束。

sentences.en: It takes time to get the vaccine to people.
sentences.zh: 让人们接种疫苗需要时间。

sentences.en: Not everyone will want to get vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 并不是每个人都愿意接种。

sentences.en: And it could be more effective for some people than for others.
sentences.zh: 而且它对某些人的效果可能比对其他人更好。

sentences.en: That being said, the best estimates that people inside the federal government have given is
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，联邦政府内部人士给出的最佳估计是，

sentences.en: that something could be available if all goes as planned by the end of the year or the beginning of next year.
sentences.zh: 如果一切按计划进行，到今年年底或明年年初，可能会有疫苗可用。

sentences.en: You know, already there are some promising candidates.
sentences.zh: 你知道，已经有一些很有希望的候选疫苗了。

sentences.en: And one of the companies that has, you know, released some of the most promising results is actually Novavax.
sentences.zh: 其中一家公布了一些最有希望结果的公司实际上就是诺瓦瓦克斯。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: This company that had never really developed a vaccine before.
sentences.zh: 这家以前从未真正开发过疫苗的公司。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They recently released some results from their early trials and they tested the blood of the people who had been given their vaccine.
sentences.zh: 他们最近公布了一些早期试验结果，并测试了接种过他们疫苗的人的血液。

sentences.en: And they found pretty high levels of antibodies against the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了针对新冠病毒的相当高水平的抗体。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: That doesn't really prove yet whether it works.
sentences.zh: 这还不能证明它是否有效。

sentences.en: We'll need those late stage clinical trials to really know for sure.
sentences.zh: 我们需要那些后期临床试验才能真正确定。

sentences.en: But it's really promising hint that it could work.
sentences.zh: 但这确实是一个非常有希望的迹象，表明它可能有效。

sentences.en: And that's gotten, you know, the scientists that we spoke to fairly optimistic about it.
sentences.zh: 这让与我们交谈的科学家们对此感到相当乐观。

sentences.en: Katie, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 凯蒂，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 感谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: On Sunday, The Times reported that the Trump administration is working with four states,
sentences.zh: 周日，《泰晤士报》报道称，特朗普政府正在与四个州合作，

sentences.en: California, Florida, Minnesota, and North Dakota, as well as the city of Philadelphia, to develop plans for distributing an eventual coronavirus vaccine.
sentences.zh: 即加利福尼亚州、佛罗里达州、明尼苏达州和北达科他州，以及费城市，共同制定最终新冠疫苗的分发计划。

sentences.en: The government is not prioritizing those communities to receive the vaccine, but instead chose them because they represent different population densities and infection rates.
sentences.zh: 政府并非优先考虑让这些社区接种疫苗，而是因为它们代表了不同的人口密度和感染率，才选择了它们。

sentences.en: Among the questions that the government is trying to answer is where to store the vaccine and what kinds of clinics should distribute it.
sentences.zh: 政府试图回答的问题包括：疫苗应储存在哪里，以及应该由什么样的诊所来分发疫苗。

sentences.en: What you are witnessing is a president of the United States who is doing everything he can to suppress
sentences.zh: 你们现在所目睹的，是一位美国总统正在竭尽全力去压制

sentences.en: the vote, make it harder for people to engage in mail-in balloting at a time when people will be putting their lives on the line by having to go out to a polling station and vote.
sentences.zh: 选票，在人们不得不冒着生命危险前往投票站投票的时刻，让人们更难参与邮寄投票。

sentences.en: On Sunday, Congressional Democrats acted to block President Trump from trying to undermine the United
sentences.zh: 周日，国会民主党人采取行动，阻止特朗普总统试图破坏美国

sentences.en: States Postal Service and mail-in voting, something that the president has suggested in interviews that he may seek to do.
sentences.zh: 邮政署和邮寄投票，而总统在采访中曾暗示他可能会这样做。

sentences.en: So what Trump is saying is, we're going to do everything we can, and this is not me talking, this is what Trump himself said.
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普的意思是，我们要竭尽所能，这不是我说的，这是特朗普本人说的。

sentences.en: House Speaker Nancy Pelosi said that she would call members back from their annual summer recess
sentences.zh: 众议院议长南希·佩洛西表示，她将召集议员们结束年度夏季休会，

sentences.en: to vote on legislation that would prevent the president from making changes to the Postal Service.
sentences.zh: 回来投票表决一项旨在防止总统对邮政署进行改动的法案。

sentences.en: At the same time, House Democrats said that they would hold an emergency hearing about the Postal Service
sentences.zh: 与此同时，众议院民主党人表示，他们将就邮政署问题举行紧急听证会，

sentences.en: and would demand to hear from the Postmaster General, a Trump ally and donor.
sentences.zh: 并要求邮政局长出席作证，此人是特朗普的盟友和捐款人。

sentences.en: Democrats said that the urgency stems from a warning from the Postal Service sent to states recently that it may not be able to meet deadlines for delivering mail-in ballots.
sentences.zh: 民主党人表示，这种紧迫感源于邮政署最近向各州发出的警告，称其可能无法满足邮寄选票的投递截止日期。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为您准备节日期间的待客之道。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人们宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝到断片才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 您可以在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢的任何播客平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
